Camera-card imports for photos and videos, with upload-date tags and JPEG covers for existing RAW/JPEG pairs.

JPEG generation now lives in the separate [Immich RAW Worker](https://github.com/Andz200zx/immich-raw-worker) project and is no longer included in this download. This update also retries transient macOS launch-service errors during installation.

Download the universal ZIP for Apple Silicon or Intel Macs. Python 3.10+ and macOS 13+ are required. See the README for installation and API-key permissions. Reinstalling preserves your configuration and sync history. The app is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.
